Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects play or digivolve any Digimon, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, this Digimon may battle 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
